verification_scope: single-node API smoke; not accuracy or full feature coverage

scenarios.serve_cmd:
# A3 release serve
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=1
export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE=AIV
export OMP_PROC_BIND=false
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1536
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7

MODEL_PATH=/root/.cache/modelscope/hub/models/Eco-Tech/InternVL3_5-241B-A28B-w8a8
case "$MODEL_PATH" in
  /*) ;;
  *) MODEL_PATH="/models/$MODEL_PATH" ;;
esac

MEDIA_DIR=/models/evidence/internvl-release-retest
media_args=()
if [[ -d "$MEDIA_DIR" ]]; then
  media_args=(--allowed-local-media-path "$MEDIA_DIR")
fi

vllm serve "$MODEL_PATH" \
  --host 127.0.0.1 \
  --port 2001 \
  --served-model-name internvl3_5 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --max-model-len 40960 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --data-parallel-size 2 \
  --max-num-seqs 70 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}' \
  --additional-config '{"weight_nz_mode":1,"enable_cpu_binding":true,"enable_fused_mc2":1}' \
  --mm-processor-cache-gb 0 \
  --enable-chunked-prefill \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --safetensors-load-strategy prefetch \
  "${media_args[@]}"
